title: Courier Operations Standard: ID-Check Handling Supplement on Express Orders (Delivery & Pickup Services)
content:
The ID-check handling supplement of a Delivery & Pickup Services express order depends on what the express order carries, as its order record shows it. The supplement forms part of the express fee on top of the express speed charge.

## Supplement

| Controlled-substance prescription in the express order | Store items in the express order | ID-check handling supplement |
|---|---|---|
| yes | yes | $2.00 |
| yes | no | $1.00 |
| no | yes | none |
| no | no | none |

An express order with no controlled-substance prescription carries no ID-check handling supplement, whatever else it carries.

## Hypothetical orders

- An express order on Kestrel Delivery Pass Annual carrying a Schedule III-IV controlled prescription and a box of store items: $2.00.
- An express order on Kestrel Pay-Per-Delivery carrying a Schedule II controlled prescription only: $1.00.
- An express order carrying a maintenance prescription and store items, no controlled substance: none.
